description: This file defines a React component named ButtonPanel that renders a set of calculator buttons, each represented by a Button component. It manages click events and passes them to a parent handler.

classes.name: ButtonPanel
classes.description: A React component that renders calculator buttons and handles their click events.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles button click events by invoking the parent clickHandler with the button's name.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the button panel with various calculator buttons.
